scope: Read-only synchronous source services reviewed against local ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3. The library owns exact selection and source traversal; CLI/host/viewer only encode selection and display inert data. Validation of profiles, XML semantics and dates remains separate from reading their declarations.

requirements.gaps: Whole-buffer source transfer. Painted image occurrences, isolated normalized image export, nested form/pattern resource inventory, folder/layout navigator behavior, full XMP/schema/date/profile validation, async output and D02b writes remain separately owned.
requirements.rule: Keep scope, object generation, original Annots/AF/RF indexes, EF keys and duplicate related-file names distinct. Preserve exact integer/text/packet/stream bytes. Original and encoded image transfers are named binary assets, not a claim of standalone image appearance. Password retries produce a separately authenticated immutable snapshot and never mutate the original handle. Downloads require explicit caller paths or fixed viewer names.
